#Module caches

The Cache API (Service Workers §5: CacheStorage, Cache) on the browser's storage (src/page/cache_store.odin): named caches of request -> response entries per origin, kept in the profile and shared by every realm of the origin (pages, workers, service workers). The engine (native/js/runtime/web_cache.c) makes the promises, the Request and Response objects; these functions are synchronous. Security for a realm that is not a secure context or has an opaque origin.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/caches.widl.

Odin: import "wren:caches".

#Cache_matchIds

string Cache_matchIds(string cache, string url, string method, string request_headers, bool ignore_search, bool ignore_method, bool ignore_vary) raises

The ids of the entries of cache matching the request (url "" = every entry), decimal, "\n"-separated. Unless ignore_vary, an entry whose response has a Vary header matches only when the named request headers are the same in request_headers ("Name: value" lines) as in its stored request (Vary: * never matches).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Cache_matchIds :: proc(c: ^Call, cache: string, url: string, method: string, request_headers: string, ignore_search: bool, ignore_method: bool, ignore_vary: bool) -> (string, Api_Error)

#Cache_entryRequestHeaders

string Cache_entryRequestHeaders(string cache, u64 id) raises

The header lines of an entry's request (Not_Found when it is gone).

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Cache_entryRequestHeaders :: proc(c: ^Call, cache: string, id: u64) -> (string, Api_Error)

#Cache_entryHead

string Cache_entryHead(string cache, u64 id) raises

An entry's head: status, statusText, the response's URL, the request's method, the request's URL, then the response's header lines, "\n"-separated (Not_Found when it is gone).

Host: Cache_entryHead :: proc(c: ^Call, cache: string, id: u64) -> (string, Api_Error)
